directive: AQGreen V2 — Owner Direction: Break the Deployment Failure Cycle

scope.area: Release history recognition for prior failed release runs

categoryDefinitions.verifiedPreMutationFailure: Authenticated complete execution evidence (workload-run identity, artifact provenance and digest, audit identity and terminal row) proves that every mutation-capable provider stage was never entered or initiated; recognition is factual and grants nothing further.
categoryDefinitions.uncertainOperation: A write may have been attempted or its outcome is unknown; reconciliation is required and automatic recognition is denied.
categoryDefinitions.confirmedMutation: An operation was attempted or completed; reconciliation is required and automatic recognition is denied.

failClosedRule: Incomplete, contradictory, missing, forged, truncated or substituted evidence must deny recognition and retain the existing reconciliation requirement. An empty mutation log alone is insufficient.
recordedFrom: Owner directive in the coordination thread; durable agent-drafted record of that business decision. Not itself new deployment, replay, financial or provider-credential authority.
